novel_policies.label: apprentice supervision requirement
novel_policies.quote: while engaging in the trade of plumbing, a licensed apprentice plumber shall be under the immediate supervision of a licensed master plumber, licensed residential master plumber, licensed journeyman plumber, or licensed residential journeyman plumber

novel_policies.label: apprentice to supervisor ratio regulated
novel_policies.quote: rules made by the commission, with the concurrence of the director, in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, regarding the ratio of apprentices allowed under the immediate supervision of a licensed supervisor

novel_policies.label: apprentice unsupervised hours allowed
novel_policies.quote: beginning in a licensed apprentice plumber's fourth year of training, a licensed apprentice plumber may work without supervision for a period not to exceed eight hours in any 24-hour period

novel_policies.label: apprentice unsupervised training year threshold
novel_policies.quote: beginning in a licensed apprentice plumber's fourth year of training, a licensed apprentice plumber may work without supervision for a period not to exceed eight hours in any 24-hour period

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours contractor
novel_policies.quote: a contractor licensee under a license issued under this chapter shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber
novel_policies.quote: a licensed plumber shall complete 12 hours of continuing education under the continuing education program established under this section

novel_policies.label: contractor qualifier license requirement
novel_policies.quote: for plumbing contractor licensure, the qualifier shall hold a master plumber license; ... for residential plumbing contractor licensure, the qualifier shall hold a master plumber license or master residential plumber license

novel_policies.label: expedited licensure pathway available
novel_policies.quote: meets the qualifications for expedited licensure as established by rules made by the commission, with the concurrence of the director, in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, that clearly demonstrate the applicant has the knowledge and skills to be a licensed master plumber

novel_policies.label: fire sprinkler work authorized
novel_policies.quote: installation, repair, or replacement of water-based fire protection systems on a Subsection (1)(h)(i) project must be performed by a licensed fire suppression systems contractor or a licensed journeyman plumber

novel_policies.label: gas supply work included in scope
novel_policies.quote: "Plumbing trade" means the performance of any mechanical work pertaining to ... delivery of gases for lighting, heating, and industrial purposes.

novel_policies.label: journeyman experience pathways
novel_policies.quote: A journeyman plumber applicant shall provide satisfactory evidence that the applicant: completed at least four-years' full-time training and instruction as a licensed apprentice plumber under supervision of a licensed master plumber or journeyman plumber ... has at least eight-years' full-time experience the division approves ... or meets the qualifications for expedited licensure

novel_policies.label: license tiers
novel_policies.quote: The division shall issue licenses under this chapter to qualified persons in the following classifications: ... apprentice plumber; ... journeyman plumber; ... master plumber; ... residential journeyman plumber; ... residential master plumber; ... general plumbing contractor; ... residential plumbing contractor.

novel_policies.label: does not require establishment regulation
novel_policies.quote: A county shall: (1) enforce the State Plumbing Code; or (2) adopt and enforce a local plumbing code that meets or exceeds the minimum standards of the State Plumbing Code

novel_policies.label: uses a certification credential
novel_policies.quote: the appropriate board of plumbing examiners shall issue a certificate to such applicant, authorizing him to engage in the business of installing sanitary plumbing

novel_policies.label: degree level: high school
novel_policies.quote: the applicant has submitted evidence that he or she has completed at least a 2 year course of study in a high school, or an equivalent course of study

novel_policies.label: lacks title protection
novel_policies.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, be he master plumber, employing plumber or journeyman plumber, to engage in the business of installing sanitary plumbing or to install sanitary plumbing for compensation or hire until such person shall have made application for and shall have received a certificate

novel_policies.label: long term compliance qualifier waiver years
novel_policies.quote: If a plumbing or electrical business entity has maintained its license and has not violated the requirements of this chapter ... for a period of five consecutive years, the business entity may maintain its license under this chapter by recording an active employee name and registration/license number from the applicable trade on the renewal application

novel_policies.label: master plumber supervisory experience required
novel_policies.quote: A master plumber applicant shall provide satisfactory evidence that the applicant: has two-years' supervisory experience as a licensed journeyman plumber in accordance with division rule

novel_policies.label: minor plumbing repair exemption
novel_policies.quote: a person engaged in minor plumbing work that is incidental, as defined by the division by rule, to the repair of a fixture or an appliance in a residential or small commercial building ... provided that no modification is made to: existing culinary water, soil, waste, or vent piping; or a gas appliance or combustion system

novel_policies.label: natural gas appliance certification required
novel_policies.quote: Any person described in Subsection (2)(b) that performs work described in Subsection (2)(a): must first receive training and certification as specified in rules adopted by the commission

novel_policies.label: natural gas facilities installation authorized
novel_policies.quote: "Qualifying installer" means a person who: a gas corporation approves to install natural gas facilities; and is: licensed under this chapter; and authorized to install natural gas facilities within the person's scope of practice as established by statute or administrative rule.

novel_policies.label: plumbing trade geographic limit feet
novel_policies.quote: "Plumbing trade" means the performance of any mechanical work pertaining to the installation, alteration, change, repair, removal, maintenance, or use in buildings, or within three feet beyond the outside walls of buildings

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours contractor: 8
novel_policies.quote: The board shall require at least eight classroom hours of instruction during each three-year licensing term.

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours contractor: 16
novel_policies.quote: proof of eight hours of instruction in code change and eight hours of instruction in other industry-related and division-approved subjects. The sixteen hours of continuing education must have been completed within the three years prior to the date of the license renewal application.

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours contractor: 4
novel_policies.quote: Each applicant for renewal of a plumbing contractor, plumber, restricted plumbing contractor, restricted plumber, or third year apprentice plumber licensed as an apprentice plumber by examination shall successfully complete a minimum of four hours of continuing education relating to the plumbing trade during the previous license period.

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours contractor: 6
novel_policies.quote: Each contractor licensee under a license issued under this chapter shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle established by rule under Subsection 58-55-303(1).

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 7
novel_policies.quote: which regulations shall require not more than a total of seven hours of accredited continuing professional education every two years

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 14
novel_policies.quote: completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 2
novel_policies.quote: a minimum of two credit hours and not to exceed four credit hours within a two-year period, of continuing education relating to the plumbing trade.

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 5
novel_policies.quote: the number of credits required shall not exceed five in any biennial license period

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 16
novel_policies.quote: proof of eight hours of instruction in code change and eight hours of instruction in other industry-related and division-approved subjects. The sixteen hours of continuing education must have been completed within the three years prior to the date of the license renewal application.

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 15
novel_policies.quote: Licensed master or journeyperson plumbers shall attend and complete a course of continuing education at their expense as determined by the board of examiners, but not to exceed fifteen (15) hours, prior to the renewal or reinstatement of an existing license.

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 6
novel_policies.quote: A person who holds a license or endorsement under this chapter must complete at least six hours of continuing professional education annually to renew the person's license or endorsement.

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 12
novel_policies.quote: a licensed plumber shall complete 12 hours of continuing education under the continuing education program established under this section

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 24
novel_policies.quote: during the past three years has completed twenty-four hours of continuing education approved by the department with the advice of the advisory board

novel_policies.label: does not require master plumber supervisory experience
novel_policies.quote: The board shall issue a license to any licensed journeyman plumber or other person who qualifies under the board's regulations and who desires to engage in the work of a master plumber, provided he passes a written master plumber's examination which shall be a standardized, nationally recognized test adopted by the board, pays the fees established by the board, and satisfies the provisions of R.S. 37:1367(B).

novel_policies.label: plumbing trade geographic limit feet: 2
novel_policies.quote: Storm sewers and rain water piping located within a building to a point two (2) feet outside of the building

novel_policies.label: plumbing trade geographic limit feet: 20
novel_policies.quote: up to 20 feet beyond the building foundation line

novel_policies.label: plumbing trade geographic limit feet: 3
novel_policies.quote: within three feet beyond the outside walls of buildings

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days: 90
novel_policies.quote: The licensee shall have 90 days after the date of disassociation in which to replace the qualifier. Upon failure to replace the qualifier within 90 days after the date of disassociation, the license shall be automatically suspended or the classification removed at the end of the 90 days.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days: 100
novel_policies.quote: the Board may issue a temporary license to the applicant, valid for 100 days, dated from the date of notification to the Board by the entity

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days: 120
novel_policies.quote: the license shall be suspended for one hundred twenty days from the date of the termination of employment or business relationship and then canceled unless another individual who is a properly certified qualifying party is approved as the qualifying party for the licensee.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days: 45
novel_policies.quote: Any entity so affected shall provide written notice of the cessation to the department of labor and training specifying the licensed master plumber, master irrigator, or master water-filtration/treatment-system installer who is replacing the departed licensed master plumber referenced in this section no more than forty-five (45) days after the effective date of occurrence of the cessation.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement notice days: 7
novel_policies.quote: the entity shall notify the Board in writing with supporting documentation within 7 days of the loss of its license holder.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement notice days: 60
novel_policies.quote: if the qualifying agent is the only certified or registered contractor affiliated with the business organization, the business organization shall notify the department of the termination of the qualifying agent and shall have 60 days from the termination of the qualifying agent's affiliation with the business organization in which to employ another qualifying agent.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement notice days: 14
novel_policies.quote: the entity shall provide written notice of the cessation to the department of health no more than fourteen (14) days after the effective date of occurrence of the cessation.

novel_policies.label: residential building unit cap: 8
novel_policies.quote: A residential jobsite shall also mean up to eight attached residential dwellings located under one roof assembly.

novel_policies.label: small project dollar threshold: 2500
novel_policies.quote: Any work or operation of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature in which the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than $2,500

novel_policies.label: small project dollar threshold: 7200
novel_policies.quote: an individual who works on one undertaking or project at a time that, in the aggregate or singly, does not exceed seven thousand two hundred dollars ($7,200) compensation a year, the work being casual, minor or inconsequential, such as handyman repairs; provided that this exemption shall not apply to any undertaking or project pertaining to the installation, connection or repair of electrical wiring, plumbing or gas fitting

novel_policies.label: small project dollar threshold: 7000
novel_policies.quote: a person engaged in the alteration, repair, remodeling, or addition to or improvement of a building with a contracted or agreed value of less than $7,000, including both labor and materials

novel_policies.label: small project dollar threshold: 25000
novel_policies.quote: Work undertaken by a person providing construction, remodeling, repair, improvement, removal, or demolition valued at $25,000 or less per project on behalf of a properly licensed contractor

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days
novel_policies.quote: If notice is given, the license shall remain in force for 60 days after the date of cessation of association or employment.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement notice days
novel_policies.quote: the licensee shall notify the division in writing within 10 days after cessation of association or employment

novel_policies.label: residential building unit cap
novel_policies.quote: "Residential building," as it relates to the license classification of residential journeyman plumber and residential master plumber, means a single or multiple family dwelling of up to four units.

novel_policies.label: residential scope limited
novel_policies.quote: "Residential journeyman plumber" means a person licensed under this chapter as a residential journeyman plumber having the qualifications, training, experience, and knowledge to engage in the plumbing trade as limited to the plumbing of residential buildings.

novel_policies.label: small project dollar threshold
novel_policies.quote: a person working on a project that has a total cost of less than $7,000 including labor, material, and changes to the agreed upon work if the construction trade: does not involve an electrical or plumbing system

novel_policies.label: does not require bonding
novel_policies.quote: any such licensed conditioned air contractor or licensed plumber may execute and deposit with the judge of the probate court in the county of his or her principal place of business a bond in the sum of $10,000.00

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days: 180
novel_policies.quote: The department shall grant an interim period of up to one hundred eighty (180) continuous calendar days to allow a company to utilize the master plumber's license of a recently deceased owner or deceased employee who procured plumbing permits for that company

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days: 30
novel_policies.quote: the plumbing contractor has 30 days after the date the master plumber no longer represents the plumbing contractor in which to designate another licensed master plumber as the representative of the plumbing contractor.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement notice days: 90
novel_policies.quote: the licensee or the qualifier shall notify the registrar in writing within 90 days after the date of disassociation. The licensee shall have 90 days after the date of disassociation in which to replace the qualifier.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement notice days: 30
novel_policies.quote: the plumbing contractor has 30 days after the date the master plumber no longer represents the plumbing contractor in which to designate another licensed master plumber as the representative of the plumbing contractor. The plumbing contractor shall notify the department in writing of the change.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement notice days: 10
novel_policies.quote: the licensee shall notify the Board in writing within 10 days after the cessation of association or employment.

novel_policies.label: does not require continuing education
novel_policies.quote: The board, by rule, may adopt continuing education requirements for licensees and may develop and produce courses, approve continuing education courses and providers, and set those fees necessary to administer these requirements.

novel_policies.label: school approval basis: unspecified
novel_policies.quote: possesses a diploma or other evidence of graduation from the eighth grade of grammar school, or possesses an equivalent education to be determined on examination

novel_policies.label: continuing education hours plumber: 4
novel_policies.quote: The Division of Master Plumbers and Journeyman Plumbers shall be authorized to require persons seeking renewal of Journeyman Plumber, Master Plumber Class I, and Master Plumber Class II licenses to complete board approved continuing education of not more than four hours annually.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: "division" means the construction industries division of the regulation and licensing department

novel_policies.label: does not require post degree experience
novel_policies.quote: The board shall require an applicant to show the degree of knowledge and experience in the classification applied for

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a department
novel_policies.quote: The State Board of Health shall have the following powers... To prescribe rules as to the qualifications, examination, and licensing of master plumbers and journeyman plumbers and for the registration of apprentice plumbers
